_comment: Step 9: every string a user reads, in English (the fallback for every other language). Keys must exist in en; other languages may only use keys that exist here (worker/test/i18n.test.mjs lists missing and extra keys). {name} style placeholders are filled by code. Plural forms: en/fr/hy one+other, ru one+few+many. Never an em or en dash.

✍️ Send /paysupport and a short note.
For example: /paysupport 500 Stars by mistake

bot.terms:
📄 Terms for tips
❤️ Axiom News is free.
⭐ A tip is voluntary and unlocks nothing.
↩️ Tips are not refunded, except one made by mistake (ask with /paysupport).
ℹ️ Telegram support cannot help with payments to bots.
🔒 We keep only who tipped, the amount, the payment id and the time.

bot.welcome_setup: 👋 Welcome to Axiom News. 🌍 Axiom News sums up the important news from about 100 trusted outlets. 📰 You will receive a short digest of the important news at the times you choose. ⚙️ Setup takes about 20 seconds: language, topics and delivery times. 👇 Tap Set up to begin.
bot.reminder: 👋 Your digest is not set up yet. ⚙️ It takes about 20 seconds. 👇 Tap Set up to begin.
bot.description:
📰 A short digest of the important news, delivered at the times you choose.

🌍 Built on reputable sources, including the Financial Times, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal and Al Jazeera
🗂 Politics, Economy, Technology & AI, Armenia, Iran, Ukraine, plus custom topics of your own (e.g. Stocks or Formula 1)
🌐 Available in several languages

🆓 Free, no ads
bot.short_description: 📰 Short digests of the important news from reputable sources, at the times you choose.

app.title: Settings
app.generic_error: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.open_in_telegram:
Open the Axiom News bot.
Send /settings and tap Open settings.
app.tip_failed: The payment did not go through.
app.help_what:
A short digest of the important news.
Delivered here, in Telegram.
At the times you choose.
Free, no ads.
app.help_stories:
We read about 100 outlets every hour.
AI groups and scores the stories.
You receive the most important ones.
No story is sent twice.
app.help_topics:
Six main topics, each on or off.
Add up to 3 of your own under My topics.
A topic that is off sends nothing.
All topics off: no digests at all.
app.help_times:
Pick 1 to 5 times a day.
They follow your phone's time zone.
app.help_lang:
Pick your language in Settings.
Your digests come in it too.
app.help_support:
Axiom News is free.
Tips in Telegram Stars are voluntary.
A tip changes nothing else.
app.help_privacy:
We keep your Telegram id and name.
And your settings, nothing more.
AI checks a topic you add.
Nothing is sold or shared.
app.delete_confirm: Delete all your data? Your settings, topics and history are removed, and the bot stops writing to you. This cannot be undone.
app.delete_owner_confirm: This is your Admin account. Delete your own data too? Admin stays yours after /start.
app.delete_done: ✅ Your data is deleted. Send /start to begin again.
app.setup_sample:
📬 A sample digest will arrive shortly.
It covers the important news of the last 24 hours.
app.all_off_hint: Switch one on to get digests.
app.help_feedback:
Ideas or problems?
Tap Send feedback.
We read every message.
